title: eriotheca ruizii
intro: Eriotheca ruizii, commonly known as the "Santo Domingo tree" or "Cordia tree", is a species of flowering plant in the bignonia family (Bignoniaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Eriotheca ruizii include analgesic, antipyretic, and antiseptic actions, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. The plant's bioactive constituents are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine for treating various health conditions.
